mujoco_manipulation · feature/obstacle-avoidance

Carrying a cube over a wall it is punished for touching

Deterministic rollouts of the warm-started OSC policy at training iteration 240. The arm starts on the goal side of a static barrier; the cube spawns on the far side. Every episode has to cross the wall twice.

  • barrier — static, 10 cm tall
  • cube — spawns at x 0.56–0.61
  • goal — airborne, x 0.37–0.43

What the policy does

  1. reach over the wall
  2. descend on the far side
  3. grasp the cube
  4. lift clear
  5. cross back at altitude
  6. descend to the goal

Crossing altitude is forced by geometry rather than asked for directly: the wall's top face sits at z 0.50, so the cube's centre has to clear z 0.52 — higher than the lowest goal, which is why the approach comes back down onto the target instead of rising monotonically.

The behavioural-cloning warm start scored 87% before any PPO; it is now at 90% and still climbing. Earlier attempts collapsed to 0% by iteration 100 — the difference is a normalization fix in the DAPG anchor, which had been scoring demonstrations under statistics that were never loaded.

The remaining failures are clean

Episode 1 in both clips ends at final_dist 0.20 m having not completed the transport — but with no wall contact. The policy is not fighting the barrier; it is running out of horizon. That is a different, easier problem than the one the collision penalty exists to solve.

Rendered with scripts/enjoy.py from outputs/pick_place_obstacle, deterministic policy, 250-step episodes at 25 fps. Small samples — the per-clip rates carry wide error bars; the 90% is the trainer's 20-episode evaluation.
